issues.detail: The Greek 'προκεκυρωμενην' (prokekyromenin) means 'pre-ordained' or 'predestined' (from keryssō - to proclaim/decree), not 'xác nhận' (confirmed/validated).

The Greek 'γεγονως' (gegonōs) means 'having happened' or 'having occurred'. The Vietnamese 'là điều đã có' (which already existed/had) misses the sense of chronological occurrence in the context of the law's establishment.
